visualReview.scope: Detailed current exterior and visible football bowl.
visualReview.notes: All fourteen portable and fourteen shared frames inspected, with full-resolution entrance, portico and north-up placement views. Revised canopy meets the retained concrete facade; upper rows clear its trusses. The apron openings reveal descending stairs, and mapped asymmetric roof/pitch outlines remain coherent. The eighty-eight porticos, open galleries, gray seating, colored portals, hospitality band, two screens, module frames and solar cells are visible.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Shared concrete, painted metal and membrane retain metric UV scale. Solar modules and glazing retain local PBR. Geographic sky-PMREM, terrain-hole visibility restoration and model-unload assertions passed.

geographicReview.notes: Exact mapped heritage perimeter and roof aperture follow the north-up placement overlay. The mapped playing-field edge directs +Z north-northeast; its obsolete dimensions are replaced by the operator’s 105 by 68 metre dimensions. Ground contact is the immediate ring esplanade and the explicit cutout protects the intentionally depressed pitch and entrance stairs.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed published exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: BCMF photographs, site plan and scaled longitudinal section establish the preserved concrete stadium and 2012 extension; operator, Cemig and Birdair evidence establish pitch dimensions, solar module inventory and membrane construction. Height levels, member sections, exact chair inventory and solar string layout remain scaled or photographic reconstructions. Enclosed service interiors, neighboring Mineirinho and the much larger urban plaza are outside this model envelope.
